news.text: 🇮🇹🧐 "#Scamacca: let's look beyond what might be an appreciation from #Spalletti, who always has #Sørloth in mind, and from #Carnevali who had him at #Sassuolo, for now there are no definitive evaluations or contacts between clubs. Still, the situation must be followed: his contract expires in 2028 and he is playing very little. #Atalanta reiterates that they are counting on him, though by not playing he wouldn't be happy to stay. It is a lead to watch carefully."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇳🇱❌ "This time #Zirkzee can leave the Premier League, though we will have to wait for #Pochettino's decisions. In Serie A, #Roma, #Juventus, #Milan and #Inter have followed him in the past, whereas today #Napoli could consider signing him. As for the bianconeri, they are looking for a center-forward with different characteristics, which is why he is not the right profile."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 #Juventus has no room for expensive investments.A reinforcement in attack is feasible: they will try to satisfy #Spalletti, but under certain conditions.Certainly not a major permanent purchase, and perhaps with an outgoing transfer at the same time.#Scamacca, #Sørloth, #Balogun and #Varela are being monitored, though there are no concrete negotiations yet.Opportunities are being evaluated to understand who might open up to a loan departure.[@DiMarzio via @PuebloJ]

⚽️🔛 #Spalletti is increasing pressure on the board to get a physical striker. His favorite is #Scamacca: for now there has been no contact with #Atalanta, though the idea could become concrete. Remaining on the list are #Sørloth (a swap with #David is being considered), #Mateta (who keeps offering himself), #Balogun (though less suited) and #Sesko (who could leave on loan). They will have to reckon with the Settlement Agreement: sell first.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🧐🗣 Kenneth #Taylor to 'IlMessaggero': "Interest from #Juventus and Premier League clubs? It's all true, my agents have informed me. However, I have already said that I am not thinking about leaving in January at all. I want to stay here and help #Lazio return to the Champions League".[@juventusinsidernews]

🇳🇱👀 #Juventus after #Taylor: the Dutchman is one of the bianconeri's targets to reinforce the midfield. He is valued at around €40M and is also being followed by #Newcastle, #Bournemouth and #Brentford. #Gattuso, however, does not want to lose him: #Lazio considers him untransferable and aims to keep the squad intact at least until the summer. Any talks will therefore potentially resume in June.[Andrea Losapio - TuttoJuve via @juventusinsidernews]

🏥ℹ️ Injury update: for #Alajbegović, a soleus muscle overload in his left leg, he will miss Omonia, but should return against #Como. On Sunday, #Kalulu and Nico #González should also be back: there is a chance the Argentine returns already for the Europa League, a match in which he would potentially start from the bench.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🤔 #Woltemade and #KoloMuani have shown they can work together, but #Spalletti does not rely on this for tactical balance: fielding both would force the attacking wingers to make a huge sacrifice in the defensive phase. For this reason, this option is used in the final stages of matches. Their understanding is growing, but the issue of finding a striker capable of guaranteeing consistency and goals still needs to be solved: a topic that could return to center stage in January.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]
